AIKIDO_CLIENT_ID.description: Aikido OAuth2 client id prefixed 'AIK_CLIENT_'. Minted at Aikido admin -> Settings -> API Keys.

AIKIDO_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Aikido OAuth2 client secret prefixed 'AIK_SECRET_' paired with AIKIDO_CLIENT_ID. Exchanged at /api/oauth/token for a short-lived Bearer on each run.

AIKIDO_MODE.description: Comma-separated list of what to import. Default 'issues'. Valid: issues (open findings -> vulns), repositories (monitored code repos -> hosts), cloud (container/cloud repos -> hosts).

AIKIDO_ISSUE_TYPE.description: Restrict issues to one group. Valid: sast | iac | secret | open_source | cloud | container | mobile | dast. Omit for all groups.

AIKIDO_MAX_PAGES.description: Hard cap on pages fetched per mode. Default 50 (= 5k rows at the default page size).

AIKIDO_SEVERITY_MIN.description: Client-side severity floor for open issues. Valid: info | low | medium | high | critical. Default 'medium'.

name: aikido
title: Aikido
description: Aikido continuous AppSec / cloud posture import. OAuth2 client credentials (AIK_CLIENT_ + AIK_SECRET_), walks the public REST API (default https://app.aikido.dev/): open issues become Faraday vulnerabilities tagged '[AGENT]' on the affected repository (or synthetic 'agent:aikido:global' host if unscoped), code and container/cloud repos become Faraday hosts tagged 'agent:aikido:*-inventory'. Set AIKIDO_ISSUE_TYPE=sast|iac|secret|open_source|cloud|container|mobile|dast to scope findings. Severity is normalised from Aikido's mixed enum/CVSS-score inputs into Faraday's info/low/medium/high/critical scheme; AIKIDO_SEVERITY_MIN drops rows below the floor. External IDs are stable so re-runs are idempotent. Pagination via page/per_page; backs off 30s on HTTP 429.
